title.narrative: IMPLEMENTATION of the EU GUEST of HONOUR at the INTERNATIONAL BOOK FAIR OF GUADALAJARA ACTIVITIES.

description.narrative:
The EU has accepted to participate as Guest of Honour (GoH) at the Guadalajara International Book Fair (FIL) at its 2023 edition.

The EU participation as GoH will broaden cultural relations and encourage cooperation and co-creation between the EU, its MS, and the LAC region while supporting global circulation of European cultural works and artists; enhance the EU¿s role and relevance for LAC and globally, focusing particularly on youth (who make up most of the subcontinent¿s population); generate strategic public and cultural diplomacy actions that could be a template to reproduce and adapt to other global regions. The selection of writers, intellectuals and artists will represent the diversity (in geography, themes, and gender) and modernity of European literature/arts/thinking. Sustainable development, the green transition and climate change will be important themes.

This contract shall serve to implement the activities of the EU GoH at the international book fair of Guadalajara.

title.narrative: Share and promote European diversity and multilingualism and support global circulation of European diverse cultural goods and services, authors and artists; Bring awareness to key EULAC priorities, in the spirit of the EULAC Road to 2023 Agenda, such as a right based, equal and inclusive society, sustainable development, the aspiration for 4 peace and liberty, green transition and climate change, human centered digital transition, in line with the New European Bauhaus approach and in an open dialogue model; Showcase the dynamics of contemporary European creation, as well as the modernity of European culture and literature; Create intergenerational dialogue opportunities, drawing from European history and cultural heritage to inspire young generations proposals and responses to present and future challenges; Promote longterm peopletopeople exchanges through culture (notably but not limited to the literature and cultural field) and foster cocreation processes while creating space for intercultural dialogue; Establish links and collaborations between EU and nonEU book professionals in LAC region and develop business opportunities for European professionals in third countries, with a focus on small independent publishers, organizations and clusters, and on small MS book markets and authors;Furthermore, at EU level, the EU participation as GoH at FIL 2023 intends to: Foster MS cooperation aiming to develop common actions at book fairs and other major international cultural events; Develop ideas, concepts and lessons learnt for a future EU participation framework, in close partnership with MS, to book fairs in different parts of the world as a public/cultural diplomacy instrument.
